abstract: Evaluating generated music requires modeling perceptual quality, technical audio quality, and prompt alignment. Existing methods often overlook signal-level defects, produce compressed quality scores, and miss fine-grained musical attributes in text prompts. We propose CloudEar, a pairwise framework for evaluating musicality and prompt alignment. It comprises three components: i) a Perceptual Expert for song-quality assessment; ii) a Diagnostic Expert for learned and signal-level quality analysis; and iii) a Cross-modal Expert for prompt-song alignment based on musical attributes. Experiments show that CloudEar outperforms the compared baselines in pairwise preference accuracy and score correlation.

oneSentenceThesis: CloudEar 针对生成歌曲评价中感知分数压缩与提示词细粒度属性缺失问题，用感知专家加诊断专家做音乐性成对比较、用跨模态专家做体裁乐器对齐比较，在三个人工标注基准上取得更高的偏好一致率与评分相关性，但结论只在给定数据划分与配对构造下成立且推理代价未被测量。
